name: Gadi
title: Father of King Menahem
summary: Gadi is known from the Bible as the father of Menahem, who became king over Israel (the Northern Kingdom). He is mentioned in connection with Menahem's seizure of power, where Menahem killed King Shallum and took the throne in Samaria. Gadi himself played no independent prominent role but is significant as the father of one of Israel's kings during a turbulent period.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Menahem's father
keyEvents.description: Gadi is identified as the father of Menahem, who rose up against King Shallum and seized power in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Menahem's revolt against Shallum
keyEvents.description: Menahem son of Gadi went up from Tirzah to Samaria and killed Shallum son of Jabesh, becoming king in his place.

keyEvents.title: Menahem's brutal conquest of Tiphsah
keyEvents.description: Menahem son of Gadi attacked the city of Tiphsah and struck down everyone there, ripping open all pregnant women, because the city had not opened its gates to him.

keyEvents.title: Menahem's reign in Israel
keyEvents.description: Menahem son of Gadi reigned over Israel in Samaria for ten years and did what was evil in the Lord's sight.

keyEvents.title: Menahem Pays Tribute to Assyria
keyEvents.description: During Menahem's reign, Pul king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave him a thousand talents of silver to keep his power.
